articles.summary: TAMPA, Fla., Sept. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Crown Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CCK) celebrated on September 9, 2026 the groundbreaking of its first beverage can manufacturing facility in India, marking a major milestone in the Company's expansion into one of the world's fastest-growing beverage markets.
articles.title: Crown Breaks Ground on the Company's First Beverage Can Manufacturing Facility in India
